note: Cadence of the automated pipeline (read by crawler/ci.py decide()). Days unless stated. budget_min is the Walmart crawl time per run. Since 2026-10-19 every department is re-crawled on one fixed interval, refresh.fixed_days (30): the measured per-department planner (crawler/cadence.py) is bypassed while it is set (0 or absent = measured intervals between min_days and max_days as before); core_every_days (consumable departments) and full_every_days (the rest) are the fallback without a plan and are kept equal to it. stale_days (the [stale-prices] alert) allows a monthly publish plus the days a crawl takes. volunteer_hours caps the pipeline's calls per minute while volunteers may be using the app's live check (same Walmart key). rollback_pause_days: no crawl starts for this long after a rollback.
